summary: A wide treatment menu and accreditations are strong, but visible typos, failed review widgets and a booking form that appears to show no fields lose enquiries.

findings.problem: Raw shortcodes [trustindex no-registration=google] and [grw id=7885] appear as text where Google reviews should load.
findings.cost: Your best proof does not show and the page looks broken.

findings.problem: Typos appear in the menu and copy: Chtswood, Qualified and Experience Doctors, frindly, tightning, rejuvanation and micro-needing in page addresses.
findings.cost: Spelling errors in a medical clinic reduce trust and hurt search ranking.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and clean page addresses.

findings.problem: The booking section appears to list options as plain text with no visible fields or submit button, and no WhatsApp or chat option appears.
findings.cost: A patient ready to book may not be able to, and every lost enquiry is lost revenue.
findings.fix: A working booking form and WhatsApp button.

findings.problem: Eyebrow Hair Transplant links to the laser page, Non-Surgical Facelift links to the thread lift page, and the Before & After section shows only an image and a link.
findings.cost: Wrong links send people to the wrong treatment and results are not shown.
findings.fix: Correct links and a real before and after gallery.

redesign: Working review widgets and a named doctor profile with credentials.
A visible booking form and a WhatsApp button on every page.
Correct treatment links and a captioned before and after gallery.
